description: This file defines a class 'sysinfo' providing methods to retrieve system information on Linux systems such as hostname, kernel version, uptime, CPU info, memory, disks, network, and peripherals. It is part of a system information script.

classes.name: sysinfo
classes.description: A class that encapsulates system information retrieval functions for Linux OS, including hardware and network details.

methods.name: sysinfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the system info object, determining distro and icon.

methods.name: vhostname
methods.description: Returns the server's hostname or 'N.A.' if environment variable is unavailable.

methods.name: chostname
methods.description: Returns the canonical hostname of the machine.

methods.name: ip_addr
methods.description: Returns the IP address associated with the hostname.

methods.name: kernel
methods.description: Retrieves the kernel version of the Linux system.

methods.name: users
methods.description: Returns the number of users currently logged in.

methods.name: loadavg
methods.description: Returns system load averages and optionally CPU load percentage.

methods.name: cpu_info
methods.description: Gathers CPU details such as model, speed, cache, and bogomips.

methods.name: ide
methods.description: Gathers IDE device info, including media type and capacity.

methods.name: sbus
methods.description: Stub for SBus info (currently returns empty).

methods.name: memory
methods.description: Collects information about RAM and swap usage.

methods.name: distro
methods.description: Returns the distribution name obtained during initialization.
